description: Preguntas a Jev (TypeSafe) en las puertas de hermes-seo (hseo_puertas.pregunta_jev). Una Choice por puerta entre los verbos que no piden texto y «persona». Jev nunca escribe un motivo: nunca rechaza ni pide cambios; solo puede dar por buena una puerta o devolverla a una persona. El estado es {puerta: {tipo, titulo, texto}, opciones: {verbo: etiqueta}, contexto: {fichero: texto}}.
instructions: You screen an approval gate of a website's SEO work on behalf of its owner. `puerta.texto` is exactly what the owner would see on the gate; `contexto` holds the documents behind it (the request, the research, the draft, the verification notes, the data). Choose the option a careful, demanding owner would choose. Choose `persona` whenever anything is missing, doubtful, unverified, contradictory, risky for the site's reputation or rankings, or would deserve a written comment: approving something wrong is much worse than asking the owner.
persona: A person must decide: something is missing, doubtful, unverified, contradictory or risky, or the gate shows warnings worth a human look
instructions_auto: You decide an approval gate of a website's SEO work on behalf of its owner, who delegated this decision to you. `puerta.texto` is exactly what the owner would see; `contexto` holds the documents behind it. Approve when the work is a faithful, reasonable answer to what was asked and is safe for the site, even if small details could be polished. Choose `persona` only for a concrete problem you can point to in the documents: a factual claim the verification did not confirm, a request left uncovered, something invented, a contradiction with the client's strategy or voice, a risk to existing rankings (cannibalisation, removed pages, redirects), or warnings on the gate. Wording, style or minor preferences are not reasons to choose `persona`. The owner can still undo your decision for a while after you take it.
persona_auto: A person must decide because of a concrete problem: an unverified claim, a request left uncovered, something invented, a contradiction with the strategy or voice, a risk to existing rankings, or warnings on the gate (not wording, style or minor preferences)

plan-tecnico.contexto: auditoria.md holds the technical audit; plan-tecnico.md the proposed technical plan.

verbos.acepto: Approve the technical plan: every item addresses a real finding of the audit, the order makes sense, and nothing risks existing rankings without saying so

plan-editorial.contexto: The documents hold market and demand data, competition and the proposed editorial plan (or the topics a radar proposes).

verbos.acepto: Approve the editorial plan: every proposed piece has measured search demand or a clear reason, none cannibalises an existing page of the site, and they fit the client's audience and goals

publicar.contexto: borrador.md is the piece; verificacion.md the fact-check (it must end APPROVED); lectura.md the reading review; publicacion.json the exact changes to publish.

verbos.acepto: Publish: the fact-check approved every claim, the reading review found nothing serious, title, meta description, links and canonical are correct, it answers the request in brief.md and it does not cannibalise another page

cambio-tecnico.contexto: analisis.md explains the change and its hypothesis; publicacion.json the exact change; verificacion.md the check.

verbos.acepto: Apply the change: it is reversible, it has a measurable hypothesis, the check found no problem, and it does not remove or redirect pages that receive traffic without saying so

decision.contexto: The report holds the period's data and at most three proposals.

verbos.acepto: Agree with the report's proposals: each one follows from the data shown, in absolute numbers, and none is a big bet without evidence

veredicto.contexto: veredicto.md compares the data before and after a published change.

verbos.acepto: Agree with the verdict: it follows from the before/after data, with enough days and impressions to say something, and it does not claim more than the data shows

mantenimiento.contexto: The findings come from the periodic, automatic check of the site.

verbos.cambio: Launch a fix: the findings are real problems (pages down, noindex by mistake, broken sitemap or links, sharp ranking drops) worth fixing; the fix still goes through its own gate
